program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
            ([cell (in-list (filter (lambda (x) (not (= (third x) 0))) (grid-cells g)))])
    (let ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell)) (v (third cell)))
      (paint-cells
        (paint-cells out (for/list ([rr (in-range (rows g))]) (list rr c)) v)
        (for/list ([cc (in-range (cols g))]) (list r cc))
        v))))
